authorized_redesign.gate: semantic-redesign-intraday-limit; disabled in the ordinary strict migration API
authorized_redesign.side: up, written explicitly from the current native default
authorized_redesign.first_hit_touch: HIGH_FOR_UP/LOW_FOR_DOWN using real raw StockMinuteBar high/low fields
authorized_redesign.reopen_transition: open means touch-to-non-touch under the native definition
authorized_redesign.clock: registered StockMinuteBar plus canonical physical session grid; absent bars do not compress first-hit slot time and transitions do not cross a missing slot
authorized_redesign.limits: raw official StockDailyBar high_limit/low_limit broadcast to the minute operator
authorized_redesign.granularity_note: No synthetic 1-minute bars are claimed. Runtime cadence remains the registered source data; the canonical grid governs physical slots and gaps.
authorized_redesign.formula_evidence_policy: The original catalog formula remains unchanged in source. Checkpoints store it alongside current_formula and SEMANTIC_REDESIGN migration_changes.

execution_evidence_validity: The redesigned current_formula differs from all earlier formulas, so earlier whole-factor execution evidence is invalid unless exact executed_formula matches. Many outer formulas retain other unresolved fields; those rows remain FIELDS_UNRESOLVED and NOT_RUN and must not be represented as executable merely because the native subexpression passes its own oracle.
